title: Changed icons to render as `<i class="ht-icon ht-icon-<name>">` elements driven by `--ht-icon-<name>` CSS variables, and extended the theme `icons` option to accept SVG strings, class lists (for icon fonts such as Tabler), or renderer callbacks (for Material Symbols ligatures). Pseudo-element icon selectors are removed and the Filters condition caption text moved into a `htUISelectCaptionLabel` child. Mirrored icons follow the grid's `layoutDirection` instead of an ancestor's `dir`, and a checkbox on a `-no-icons` bundle shows the theme's box with no tick instead of a native checkbox. The `iconsMap()` theme helper is deprecated in favor of `iconStyles()`; see the 19.0 migration guide.
